[[File:Koen Meijssen 2022 Endor Grand Prix.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Koen Meijssen at the [[2022 Endor Grand Prix]].]]
'''Koen Meijssen''' won the [[DecipherCon 1999 Team Event]] with [[Martin Akesson]], [[Paul Todd Feldman]] and [[Yannick Lapointe]].<ref name="trando-iv7">[https://web.archive.org/web/20041026204829/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/iv7.htm Martin Akesson interview], [[Trandosite]] (31 August 2000)</ref> He also played the [[2026 European Championship]].<ref name="pc-euro">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-10-european-championship-bochum-germany-sept-19-20-2026/ 2026-10 European Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref>
